name: feature-delivery
invariants: No write-capable node is reachable before the current brief is approved: user_explicitly_approved, or auto_approved_by_policy when .ai-harness/harness.json sets approval to auto and the brief records its choices as decisions with nothing left in needs_human or open_questions.
A blocking finding cannot transition directly to done.
Every repair is followed by required checks and re-review.
publish commits, pushes, and opens a PR only as .ai-harness/harness.json git_policy allows; it never merges, force-pushes, or pushes to the base branch.

Work that was pushed is not done until remote CI for the pushed commit has finished green or the repository has no remote CI; local runs of the CI commands do not stand in for it, a failure goes back through repair, and remote CI that cannot be observed ends as unverified, never as done.
The delivery node follows the project test policy: TDD, required, recommended, or no automated-test requirement.
